name: fc660-parallel-smash
description: New-York parallel drum smash through the UADx Fairchild 660: a hard-crushed wet (hot input, high threshold = lots of GR, Time Constant 1 = fastest, sidechain filter Off) blended back via the plugin's own MIX knob at ~40%, so the dry transients return while the wet adds tube density + aggression underneath. Measured on the Watercolors warm drum bus: crest 17.17->15.34 (denser), low-band punch 27.15->24.9, LRA 2.44->2.27, +1.81 LU, true-peak -0.98 — bigger/denser, the dry blend keeps the attack.
intended_for: a drum bus / room you want bigger and more aggressive without losing the dry punch
plugin_build: uaudio_fairchild_660.vst3 (UADx native — renders headless; not the .component twin)
notes: MIX is the built-in parallel blend (100 = fully wet). Crush the wet hard (high input + high thresh + fast TC), then dial MIX 30-50% to bring the dry punch back.
TIME_CONST 1 is the fastest position (catches transients, lowest crest = most controlled). Speed up the wet to slam it; the dry blend restores attack.
INPUT 0 = hottest drive (most GR + most harmonic color). HEADROOM 12 runs it a touch hotter than the default 16.
Re-dial MIX by ear/crest to taste; lower MIX = more dry punch, higher = more density.
